title: The Proposal
dialogue: Psst — I've got a ring in my pocket and I'm sweating through my shirt. Can you help make this moment special?

interventions.label: Comp a bottle of bubbly
interventions.successText: They said yes! The room erupts and three tables order celebratory rounds.

interventions.label: Dim the lights, cue the song
interventions.description: Charm check. Free, but timing is everything.
interventions.successText: Perfect timing. Someone films it — your bar is trending tonight.
interventions.failText: The song cuts in mid-sentence. Awkward laughter, but still a yes.

ignoreText: They pop the question on their own. Polite applause; life goes on.

title: Rowdy Table
dialogue: OI! ANOTHER ROUND! And turn the music UP, this is a PARTY!

interventions.label: Send the bouncer over
interventions.successText: A quiet word and a firm nod. The table settles; the room relaxes.

interventions.label: Water & fries on the house
interventions.description: −$12. Charm check to calm them down.
interventions.successText: Carbs and hydration work their magic. They tip on the way out.
interventions.failText: They throw a fry at the dartboard. Two couples leave early.

ignoreText: They get louder for a while, then fizzle out on their own.

title: Incognito Critic
dialogue: Tell me — is your stout nitrogenated in-line, or are you just pouring from a widget can like a heathen?

interventions.label: Pour a tasting flight
interventions.successText: They scribble furiously. Next week's column: "a hidden gem with a serious pour."
interventions.failText: The head collapses in seconds. They sigh audibly and leave a one-star review.

interventions.label: Talk shop with them
interventions.successText: You bond over gas blends. They leave a business card and a generous tip.
interventions.failText: You mispronounce 'Saison'. They nod politely and finish their drink.

ignoreText: They finish their drink in silence and leave no review. Neutral.

title: Lost Tourist
dialogue: Hi! My phone died and I have no idea where my hotel is. Also — what's the local thing to drink here?

interventions.label: Draw a map on a napkin
interventions.successText: They photograph the napkin for their travel blog. Five stars.

interventions.label: Pour them the local lager
interventions.description: +$9 sale, charm check for a tip.
interventions.successText: They love it, buy a second, and tip generously.
interventions.failText: They drink it, shrug, and head off into the night.

ignoreText: Another patron helps them out. They wave on the way out.

title: Birthday Round
dialogue: It's my 21st and my friends bailed. Is it lame to ask for a birthday shout-out?

interventions.label: Round on the house
interventions.successText: The whole bar sings. They're crying happy tears into a cider.

interventions.label: Get the staff to sing
interventions.successText: Off-key but heartfelt. The staff are grinning for the rest of the shift.

ignoreText: They quietly finish their drink. Someone at the bar buys them a shot.

title: Tab Dodger
dialogue: …*edges towards the door with a $38 tab still open*

interventions.label: Bouncer blocks the door
interventions.successText: "Forgetting something, mate?" They pay up, plus tip, very red-faced.

interventions.label: Call out politely
interventions.successText: "Oh! Totally forgot!" They settle the tab.
interventions.failText: They bolt. The tab is a write-off.

ignoreText: They slip out. You eat the $38 tab, but the floor never noticed.

title: Spilled Pint
dialogue: Aw, no — someone knocked my full pint all over the counter. Just poured too.

interventions.label: Replace it on the house
interventions.successText: "This is why I come here." They tell their mates.

interventions.label: Towel and a joke
interventions.successText: They laugh it off and order another at full price.
interventions.failText: The joke lands like the pint did. They grumble.

ignoreText: They mop it up with napkins and order another.

title: Supplier Rep Drops By
dialogue: Hey boss! Brought samples of our new hazy IPA. Fancy a chat about volume pricing?

interventions.label: Negotiate a rebate
interventions.successText: You talk them into a $60 marketing rebate. Nice.
interventions.failText: They promise to 'circle back'. They will not circle back.

interventions.label: Staff tasting session
interventions.successText: The team loves it. Spirits are high (and slightly hazy).

ignoreText: They leave a brochure on the counter and go.

title: Heartbreak at the Bar
dialogue: She took the dog. She took the good frying pan. She took… everything. Pour me something strong.

interventions.label: Lend an ear, pour a lime soda
interventions.successText: An hour of venting later, they leave lighter. A regular for life.
interventions.failText: They appreciate it, but head somewhere that will pour doubles.

interventions.label: Call them a cab
interventions.successText: They text the bar's socials the next day: 'thank you for looking after me.'

ignoreText: They nurse a whiskey and leave after midnight. Neutral.
